summary: A interactive spacecraft simulator with storytelling and real world physics, procedures and data including space orbit and deep space travel along with a key focus on research and innovation.
details: A detailed first-person spacecraft rocket mission with interactive dials buttons and displays along with special missions and events replicating real world launch-seq and mechanical failures. The game consists of textured cockpits detailed planets and vast solar system. Language: C# Engine: unity 6.6. Using VScode with claude code. The game is creative as it consists of two game modes one consisting of regular launch sequences and a story based survival research game that is to be expanded. Stranded but surviving. All factors including real world data, figures and physics
